name: Song of Discord, Greater — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Song of Discord, Greater from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Song Of Discord Greater" but are not part of the Song of Discord, Greater entry, which is unchanged.

Song of Discord, Greater

School enchantment (compulsion) [mindaffecting, sonic]; Level bard/skald 6, mesmerist 6, psychic 8
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like song of discord except that affected creatures automatically attack the nearest target each round. In addition, all affected creatures gain a +4 morale bonus to Strength for the duration of the spell. A creature that succeeds at the Will save reduces the effect’s duration to 1 round.
